description: This file contains base classes and utility functions for build performance testing, including test result handling, cache management, and system resource measurement within a build environment.

classes.name: KernelDropCaches
classes.description: Provides methods to check permissions and drop kernel caches to ensure clean build environments.

classes.name: ResultsJsonEncoder
classes.description: Custom JSON encoder to serialize datetime and timedelta objects in build test results.

classes.name: BuildPerfTestResult
classes.description: Custom test result class that records and outputs detailed build performance test results.

classes.name: BuildPerfTestCase
classes.description: Base class for individual build performance tests, providing setup, teardown, and resource measurement methods.

classes.name: BuildPerfTestLoader
classes.description: Custom test loader for build performance tests.

classes.name: BuildPerfTestRunner
classes.description: Custom test runner that creates test result objects for build performance testing.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks permissions for dropping kernel caches.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Drops kernel caches to ensure clean build environment.

methods.name: str_to_fn
methods.description: Converts a string into a sanitized filename.

methods.name: default
methods.description: Encodes datetime and timedelta objects into JSON-compatible formats.

methods.name: addSuccess
methods.description: Records a successful test result.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Records a test error result.

methods.name: addFailure
methods.description: Records a failed test result.

methods.name: addExpectedFailure
methods.description: Records an expected failure.

methods.name: startTest
methods.description: Prepares for a test execution.

methods.name: startTestRun
methods.description: Marks the start of a test run.

methods.name: stopTestRun
methods.description: Marks the end of a test run.

methods.name: all_results
methods.description: Aggregates all test results with statuses.

methods.name: write_buildstats_json
methods.description: Outputs build statistics to a JSON file.

methods.name: write_results_json
methods.description: Outputs test results to a JSON file.

methods.name: write_results_xml
methods.description: Outputs test results to an XML file in JUnit format.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares environment before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans environment after each test.

methods.name: run_cmd
methods.description: Executes a command with logging and error handling.

methods.name: measure_cmd_resources
methods.description: Measures system resource usage of a command execution.

methods.name: measure_disk_usage
methods.description: Estimates disk usage of a file or directory.

methods.name: save_buildstats
methods.description: Saves build statistics related to a measurement.

methods.name: rm_tmp
methods.description: Removes temporary files and directories.

methods.name: rm_sstate
methods.description: Removes sstate cache directory.

methods.name: rm_cache
methods.description: Removes persistent cache directory.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes filesystem and drops kernel caches.

methods.name: _makeResult
methods.description: Creates a new test result object.
